verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents an API and data platform: a public OTLP ingest endpoint at /api/public/otel, Metrics API v2, querying via the Python/JS SDKs, scores via API/SDK, and a CLI for terminals and coding agents. A long-term user independently confirms the OpenAPI spec is easy to implement in any language and lets them drive only the parts of the product they choose. The probe's 404s on guessed OpenAPI paths and one report of slow bulk trace retrieval are depth caveats, not contradictions. Missing for 10: a first-party API reference excerpt covering endpoint breadth and authentication, a discoverable OpenAPI spec at a standard location, and evidence of performant bulk read access.
